home.title: Silt
home.lede: A Minecraft SMP built around its community, its stories, and the strange little world that developed between them.
home.aboutText:
Siltvale is a Minecraft survival multiplayer server built around its players and the world they create together.

This website serves as an archive of the server: its history, community, information, and everything that makes Siltvale what it is.

More information about the SMP will be added here once the official details are available.

info.title: Survive
info.lede: Siltvale is a lore-focused, ARG-inspired Minecraft server built around environmental storytelling, mystery, and immersive roleplay.

figure.alt: Dithered title page of a 16th-century book of machines
figure.caption: Diverse and artificial machines — a book passed down between generations

info.body:
The world is filled with forgotten settlements, abandoned places, hidden records, and clues left behind by those who came before. Rather than simply telling its story, Siltvale allows players to discover it for themselves.

Explore the world, uncover strange records, solve puzzles and ciphers, and slowly piece together the history of a world that has been lost to time.

Every ruin, journal, and landmark may hold a piece of something larger.

offers.title: Immersive Roleplay
offers.text: Take part in collaborative storytelling where players help shape the world and its unfolding narrative.

offers.title: Environmental Lore
offers.text: Discover stories hidden within the environment, from forgotten settlements and landmarks to records left behind by earlier inhabitants.

offers.title: Puzzles & Ciphers
offers.text: Follow clues, decipher strange messages, and solve ARG-inspired puzzles scattered throughout the world.

offers.title: A World to Explore
offers.text: Explore a post-apocalyptic world shaped by discovery, player exploration, and the traces of a civilization that came before.

offers.title: A Welcoming Community
offers.text: Siltvale is built around its players, creating a community-driven experience where people can explore, create, and tell stories together.

info.goalText: To create a world players will remember, and a place they'll always want to return to.

history.title: The History
history.lede: A record of the world before the Plague, the fall of Siltvale, and the generations that eventually returned to reclaim it.
history.footageAlt: Recovered footage of the vale: an overgrown structure beneath a great tree, fog across the ground
history.footageNote: Recovered footage — the vale as the returning parties found it

legend.title: The Silt Plague
legend.text: The disaster that consumed the old world.

legend.title: The Siltwraiths
legend.text: The dead, changed into something beyond death.

legend.title: The Reclaiming
legend.text: Descendants return to the homeland generations later.

ages.label: Before the Silt
ages.title: The Age of Discovery
ages.body:
Eons ago, during what descendants would eventually call the Renaissance period, the world stood on the brink of an age defined by knowledge and machinery.

The enlightenment shaped the lives of countless peoples. New discoveries were being made, and technology was beginning to move the world toward a future built upon machinery.

That momentum would never reach its conclusion.

ages.label: The Plague
ages.title: The Silt

figure.alt: Dithered plate of pale lichens and mosses
figure.caption: Natural record / Silt — pale moss

ages.body:
The Silt Plague spread across the world. Gray and faintly fine beneath the sun, the Silt moved across continents and swallowed the homes of different races.

It brought tides of disease with it. Biomes withered, settlements disappeared, and the vibrance of the world slowly faded beneath the spreading Silt.

aside.title: Pale Moss
aside.text: Pale moss became one of the remnants associated with the Silt. Life continued to grow within the ruins of the old world, intertwining with abandoned structures and forgotten machinery.

ages.label: The Creaking
ages.title: The Siltwraiths

figure.alt: Dithered woodcut of skeletons sounding trumpets
figure.caption: Entity record — the Creaking

ages.body:
The Silt did not merely consume lives. Over decades, it acquired enough consciousness — enough residue from those it had claimed — to become something new.

From the drifting haze emerged creatures unlike anything the world had previously known.

> Never turn your back.
-- An old warning passed between survivors

> Don't look away.
-- The Creaking

aside.title: The Creaking
aside.text: Siltwraiths became the beginning of the apocalypse. They emerged from the haze as the world was already being consumed, turning the remains of the dead against the living.

ages.label: The Fall
ages.title: The End of Siltvale
ages.body:
The Silt Plague and the apocalypse of the Siltwraiths eventually consumed Siltvale.

The survivors had little choice. They fled the choking Silt and scattered across distant islands.

Those scattered populations began forging a thalassocracy — bound together by the ocean and by a shared history that could not be forgotten.

> The homeland was lost, but its history travelled with those who survived.

ages.label: Generations later
ages.title: The Reclaiming

figure.alt: Dithered wash drawing of a ship caught among ice
figure.caption: The crossing — a vessel of the scattering

ages.body:
Generations passed. The descendants of those populations who survived eventually turned their attention back toward the mainland.

> The Plague has ended and the Siltwraiths have become nocturnal. The mainland — our homeland — is to be reclaimed.

Word spread across the islands. The homeland that had been abandoned was no longer unreachable.

The descendants would return to Siltvale and attempt to reclaim what had been lost.

ages.label: The Return
ages.title: What Remains
ages.body: The Siltwraiths still thrive at night. Their existence raises questions that remain unanswered.

questions.title: Residue
questions.text: Are the Siltwraiths simply residue left behind by death, or is there something more within them?

questions.title: Behavior
questions.text: Do they possess patterns, behaviors, communication, or even emotions?

ages.after: Whatever the answer may be, the Siltwraiths remain a reminder of the lives lost during the Plague.

ages.label: The New World
ages.title: A Shattered World

figure.caption: Machine studies — knowledge from before the Plague

ages.body:
The reclaiming of Siltvale is not simply a battle against monsters. It is a struggle to survive within a world that no longer resembles the one remembered by history.

Machinery lies abandoned and overgrown, remnants of knowledge from an age that existed before the Plague.

Descendants rediscover these machines and technologies through knowledge passed down between generations.

Nature has grown over the remains of civilization. Ruins, machinery, moss, and forgotten technology now exist together.

fate.title: What awaits your fate?
fate.text: Islands foreign to one another, yet bound by the same history, set sail toward the land they once all called home.
questions: Will you trust another foreign soul?

faq.record: Frequently asked questions / Siltvale community archive
faq.title: FAQ

panels.title: Reader's note
panels.text: If you're new to Siltvale, this record should answer most of the questions you might have.

panels.title: Before you enter
panels.text: Siltvale is a community-driven world. There isn't one story waiting for you to follow. You help create it.

items.a:
Siltvale is currently in development. An official launch date will be announced once we're confident everything is ready.

Accepted players will receive the server IP before launch.

items.q: Are there main characters or antagonists?
items.a:
No. Siltvale is a community-driven Minecraft server where players contribute to an evolving world through their characters, stories, and interactions.

It's up to you how you make your story matter.

items.q: Can I stream or make videos?
items.a: Yes! Content creation is encouraged. We love seeing players create videos, streams, screenshots, artwork, and other content inspired by Siltvale.

Not at all! Previous roleplay experience is helpful but not required.

We welcome both experienced and new roleplayers.

items.q: How will we communicate while roleplaying?
items.a: We use both VC and Minecraft chats depending on preference and availability.

items.q: What's the biome of Siltvale's setting? Is it fully dead?
items.a:
Siltvale's settlements have the following biomes: Pale Biome, Dark Forest, Birch Forest, Old Growth Spruce Taiga, and a snowy mountain.

Therefore, Siltvale is not fully dead, considering it's been eons since the Plague and Apocalypse.

"We will start where most descendants first arrived at Siltvale."
There are exceptions, as long as the race is not used to make the OC overpowered or turn them into a "chosen one" type of character.

items.q: Where will the first RP session begin?
items.a: We will start where most descendants first arrived at Siltvale.

items.q: Can players create their own groups?
items.a:
For groups, what actually matters is the lore and background.

It depends on the situation. For example, a group could have originally disbanded and your OC decides to recruit people to make it active again.

Or it could simply be a group your OC decides to establish from scratch.

Naturally, a recruitment post can then be made for it.

items.q: Will there be player-made civilizations and factions?
items.a:
Since the theme is reclamation, the settlements where players can reside are already made.

Players can add their own builds there. Groups can also create their own bases.

items.q: How do the settlement roles work?
items.a:
Settlements already exist as part of Siltvale's reclaimation theme.

Roles such as Settler, Drifter, Pathfinder and others help define how characters interact with the world.

items.q: How does roleplay actually work? Is it instant?
items.a:
As long as you're around people, yes. However, it's completely okay to be idle if you're by yourself.

Roleplay naturally happens around the people and situations you're interacting with.

Yes! You can apply for multiple roles, such as lore writer, builder, moderator, and player at the same time.

We encourage it as long as you're up for the additional responsibility.

items.q: Will players be able to trade?
items.a:
Yes. What players trade for is their choice.

For example, you could trade one item for another player's item that you need.

items.q: Who do I contact if I have questions?
items.a: Feel free to open a Ticket or contact a member of the staff team.

faq.goalText: Siltvale is still being built. Some answers will change as the world, community, and story continue to develop. If something isn't covered here, ask the community.

ack.record: Siltvale / People who helped make this possible
ack.title: Acknowledgements
ack.intro: Siltvale will continue to grow from here on out, and I want to acknowledge the people who helped carry it. Even when Siltvale was still uncertain, messy, an idea slowly becoming real, these were the people who stayed, created, contributed, and believed in what it could become.

posters.name: Rogue
posters.ack:
Thank you for all of your support behind the scenes within Siltvale. “We’re in this together.” That genuinely meant a lot more than I could put into words!

Thank you for trusting in me and keeping up despite my messy pace, for always understanding, hearing me out, and choosing to stay and listen no matter how complicated things seem. I want you to always remember that I appreciate your hard work and I see your efforts.

posters.name: Timfinn
posters.ack: Thank you for being one of the earliest people to help shape the direction and atmosphere of Siltvale. Your ideas, support, and presence during development genuinely mattered more than you probably realize.

posters.name: breadzyy_
posters.ack: Thank you for constantly showing up and bringing life into Siltvale through your assistance and builds. The abandoned factory, sewer entrance, and the atmosphere you helped create became part of what makes the world feel real.

posters.name: Phasma
posters.ack:
Thank you for contributing not only through builds, but also through the ideas you brought into the world. Your contributions helped expand Siltvale beyond just structures and into something with depth and story.

Thank you for pouring your passion in creating into Siltvale! I’m so proud of everything you’ve built. I genuinely appreciate you taking initiatives and contributing so much help!

posters.name: Zay
posters.ack:
Thank you for the creativity and energy you brought into Siltvale. You pushed yourself to learn a lot of things you didn’t know and gained a lot of experience. Be proud of your achievements!

You’ve helped lay the foundation of Siltvale in more ways than you realize.

posters.name: Mel
posters.ack: Thank you for bringing much more stable and reliable hosting to Siltvale. Your support and work within the server have genuinely made the launch much more possible. You took a huge part in taking actions towards launch, and thank you for teaching me a lot as well!

posters.name: Garcalarci
posters.ack:
Thank you for bringing more life into Siltvale, not just through its lore but especially within the community. Knowing that you chose to take on this role partly because you believed in me, in Siltvale, and in everything I’ve worked for means more than I can put into words.

I know you’ve given up being “simply a player” to help with something that matters so much to me, and I don’t take that lightly. It means the world to me.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.lede: Words from the people who experienced Siltvale.
reviews.intro: Siltvale is built around the people who choose to become part of it. These are some of the thoughts, experiences, and words shared by members of the community.

items.title: Easily one of the best!
items.author: fluttersnow
items.text:
Siltvale is such a unique SMP, especially because of how much thought goes into the lore. It actually feels like you're part of a world with a history rather than just another Minecraft server.

The community is great, the atmosphere is amazing, and there's always something to look forward to. Definitely a server I'd recommend joining if you're looking for an SMP you can actually get invested in!

items.title: Siltvale SMP
items.author: phasmanthusz
items.text: Guys guys you should 100% join this super cool Minecraft server! Everyone's really welcoming and fun and the lore + builds are suuuuper duper awesome!

items.author: garcalarci
items.text: The people are all so friendly and nice, especially that Garlic fella! Also the OOC events are fun!

items.title: IT'S AMAZING!!!
items.author: lejek63
items.text:
Great moderation, NO CLUTTER, constant OOC events and did I mention that the moderation's great?

Like, literally, this server's mods are the most helpful people I've ever met. I haven't been a part of this server for too long and I already know that it's great.

You should absolutely join!!! We're going to have the best lore there is out there!

items.title: My Siltvale experience
items.author: funderstorm630tre
items.text: Everyone there is friendly and it is nice to work on something creative with others following the same goal.

items.title: AVESOME (or is it AWESOME) SERVER
items.author: breadzyy__
items.text: The server is really cool and friendly. All the people are friendly and nice. It has reallyy nice lore and a really cool world. Super excited for launch.

reviews.goalText: Every person who joins Siltvale becomes part of its story. Whether you've been here from the beginning or just arrived, your experience helps shape the community and the world we're building together.
